text:
</sub>  Treat whitespace-only model identifiers as absent

When an OpenAI-compatible endpoint returns a whitespace-only `model` value, this condition records it as `reportedModel` even though it identifies no model. Benchmark evidence can then treat the identity field as present rather than taking the intended unattested, fail-closed path, potentially admitting an invalid same-version comparison. Reject strings whose trimmed value is empty while preserving valid reported identifiers.
